The post-soak official metadata/source refresh retained the unchanged database and eight earlier actual candidate18 scans. It did not execute eight new scans. Future component or consumer changes require reassessment.

Seven core local observers each completed four actual hours and 480 samples. A separate touch-emulated public mobile session also completed four hours and 480 samples. This is sampled execution evidence, not continuous provider uptime, universal code correctness or long-term availability. Earlier failed/interrupted observations retain their original scope.
Google photographic imagery has varying capture dates and is not live satellite imagery. Rendered scene/API agreement does not establish source-location ground truth or confirm an incident.

Public data is limited to attributed NASA thermal observations and regional adsb.lol snapshots. Thermal detections do not identify strikes; aircraft broadcasts do not establish missions or ownership. Missing observations do not establish absence.

Public dataset freshness describes cached publication age. Saved long-run records do not establish all-region ADS-B uptime or every NASA fetch attempt. Exact batch downloads and configured geographic limits remain explicit.

Private report text, Telegram, GOOL context/costs and generated Media/Brief are withheld from the public profile. Private RSS had sampled failures and age-stale publications; upstream failure causes were not retained by the observer and remain unverified.

Desktop Chromium/Firefox/WebKit viewport and touch checks are not physical iPhone/Safari qualification. The separate four-hour mobile session used desktop Chromium at 390 x 844 with touch/DPR 3; physical phone RAM/GPU, OS background eviction and sustained mobile usability remain unqualified.

Public page JavaScript peaked at 986.233 MiB in the main observer and 1,011.279 MiB in the raster observer; the separate mobile emulation peaked at 732.500 MiB page JavaScript and 1,913.508 MiB Windows-job committed memory. The main observer does not decode raster PNGs. These results establish neither leak freedom nor a safe phone memory budget.

Media verification used retained artifacts and an isolated read-only replay API, not fresh model generation or production FastAPI/database ingestion. Firefox paused-caption repaint/callback limitations and Windows WebKit raw color mismatch remain recorded; no listener-audibility claim is made.

The local restore checked 17 tables and six sequence bounds using an isolated temporary dump. Encrypted off-machine backups, host disaster recovery and automatic startup/outage recovery remain unqualified.

Local public-rate/load tests do not qualify Internet capacity. Public TLS, restricted Google imagery credentials and quotas, host maintenance, recovery, shared GOOL capacity and website navigation coordination remain pre-site requirements.
The five-image inventory identifies the candidate. Individual browser, replay and restore checks exercised only their stated roles; the tunnel image was not exercised by the four-hour observers.

The April archive remains preserved separately; quarantined placeholder coordinates were not silently merged into live observations. Historical test results and earlier pending matrix prose retain their original context and do not override the current hash-bound review records.
